brief:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu claimed that Muslim Brotherhood supporters are "raiding" polling stations in Israel, Middle East Eye reported. He framed the alleged incidents as part of a broader conflict, stating "We're at war for our home."

Netanyahu's allegations emerged amid what he characterized as coordinated disruptions at voting locations, though the report provided no independent verification of the claims or detailed accounts of specific incidents at polling sites.

title: Netanyahu accuses Muslim Brotherhood supporters of raiding polling stations
